data.narrative:
Deepnight is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Lucas Young and Thomas Li that has raised $5.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of two public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic operating in the same sector.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $5.5M raised as a proxy base valuation, applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $14M. The peer-median method examines three same-sector, same- or adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). This cohort produces a median valuation of $400M with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range: $12M (low), $207M (median), and $460M (high). The stage-progression method implies a substantially lower valuation tied directly to capital deployed, while peer median reflects valuations of more mature or higher-capitalized competitors. Key uncertainties include whether Deepnight's technology differentiation and market traction justify positioning within the upper quartile of the peer set versus the early-stage capital-based lower bound. Further diligence on product validation and customer pipeline would clarify appropriate placement within the $12M–$460M range.
